faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Portola Valley homeowners typically invest $18,000 to $55,000+ for window replacement projects. This ultra-exclusive Peninsula community features custom estate homes on large lots where premium Marvin, Western Window Systems, or Andersen specifications are the norm. Projects covering 20–35+ windows with custom sizing are common.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Yes. Portola Valley requires a building permit for window replacements. The Town's Planning Department may also review projects for consistency with the community's rural, open-space character. Our team manages all Town of Portola Valley permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Portola Valley commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Portola Valley replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Most Portola Valley projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
